cpmplus.w6save.ghost.missing: %s: your model has no '%s' folder, so the game shows the normal Minecraft part there (Blockbench does not show it).
cpmplus.w6save.ghost.off: %s: the folder '%s' has export turned off, so the game shows the normal Minecraft part there.
cpmplus.w6save.ghost.nested: %s: the folder '%s' is inside '%s'; it only becomes a body part outside every folder. Until then the game shows the normal Minecraft part.
cpmplus.w6save.ghost.consequence: Armor and items stay attached to this body part, even when it is hidden.
cpmplus.w6save.ghost.fix.hide: Hide the normal part (creates the empty folder in the right place)
cpmplus.w6save.ghost.fix.keep: I want the normal part (show it in Blockbench)
cpmplus.w6save.limits.frames: Animation '%s' has %s frames; the game only keeps up to 255 (it becomes %s): it plays only the start, in slow motion.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.duration: Animation '%s' lasts %s s; the game maximum is 32.7 s. Beyond that it breaks in game. Split it in two or shorten it.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.parts: Animation '%s' moves %s parts; the game only accepts 255 per animation, and the motion lands on the wrong part. Split it into two animations.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.fixFrames: Adjust: fewer frames per second (or open Optimize animation when the keys sit on a grid)
cpmplus.w6save.limits.fpsDone: '%s': from %s to %s frames/s, %s/255 frames. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.size: '%s' is %s px on the %s axis. The game limits each cube to 25.5 px, so it becomes %s px. Split it into smaller cubes.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.negSize: '%s' has a negative size on the %s axis. In game it becomes 0 (it disappears).
cpmplus.w6save.limits.pos: '%s' is %s px (%s axis) from the pivot of the folder above. The game stops at 48 px, so it shows at %s px. Put the part in a folder with a closer pivot.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.fixPivot.preview: Moves the pivot of folders without rotation (that only hold other folders) onto the pivot of the folder above. Nothing changes place, not even in animations. Fixes all of them at once; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.pivotDone: %s pivots moved to the folder above; nothing changed place. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.offset: Cube '%s' starts %s px (%s axis) from its own pivot. The game stops at 48 px (it becomes %s px). Move the pivot near the cube.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.anim: Animation '%s': '%s' reaches %s in %s. The game stops at 48 (it becomes %s). Reduce that motion or use an intermediate folder.
cpmplus.w6save.limits.more: And %s more things over the game limits (fix the ones above and export again to see them).
cpmplus.w6save.limits.consequence: In game the part is cut or in the wrong place (Blockbench shows it right).
